note: Open talent trees. Only the ranger tree is implemented in the early battle runtime.

nodes.name: Steady String
nodes.description: Projectile speed +10%. Arrows reach targets sooner, allowing more branch generations within the same shared lifetime; does not directly increase continuation chance.

nodes.name: Long Breath
nodes.description: Shared projectile lifetime +8%. Effective generations use the entire arrow lineage's shared lifetime; child arrows do not gain independent lifetimes.

nodes.name: Keen Eye
nodes.description: Hunter's Mark duration +10%. Extends the mark's actual expiry tick when cast; does not change cooldown, damage multiplier, or cast range.

nodes.name: Light Step
nodes.description: Dash duration +10%. Total distance stays the same, with per-tick movement spread over the longer duration; does not change cooldown or damage immunity.

nodes.name: Composure
nodes.description: Dodge cooldown recovery +8%. Shortens the base 35-tick cooldown when Dodge begins; duration and invulnerability frames stay unchanged.

nodes.name: Close-Range Turn
nodes.description: Minimum turn time -8%. Reduces the time needed for one branch generation, allowing more effective generations in the same lifetime; does not directly increase branching chance. Requires 3 points in tier 1 of this tree.

nodes.name: Continuation Calibration
nodes.description: p overflow conversion to ordinary damage +20%. Applies only when equipment pushes p above 100%: each excess point contributes 1.2x to ordinary continuation damage. p itself remains capped at 100% and adds no branches. Requires 3 points in tier 1 of this tree.

nodes.name: Lost-Target Pursuit
nodes.description: Retain a candidate for 0.5 seconds after losing a marked target. When the mark expires or the target leaves valid range, retain it only as Piercing Arrow's priority target for 15 ticks; does not restore the mark's damage multiplier. Requires 3 points in tier 1 of this tree.

nodes.name: Windcut Stance
nodes.pending_reason: Required base rules do not exist yet: enemy interruption pressure, interruption-resistance thresholds, and a one-use post-Dash trigger window
nodes.description: Not implemented: the next skill after Dash gains +25% interruption resistance. Requires enemy interruption pressure, resistance thresholds, and a one-use post-Dash trigger window. Current combat lacks these rules, so points cannot be assigned.

nodes.name: Lineage Insight
nodes.description: Expanded battle reports show time per generation and shared lifetime remaining after each complete generation, making arrow lineage time use easier to compare. Adds readouts only; changes no values. Requires 3 points in tier 1 of this tree.

nodes.name: Final-Generation Reload
nodes.description: Retain 15% of expired undelivered payload. If Piercing Arrow completes its frozen path without hitting, retain 15% of settled arrow events for the next arrow that hits. Does not directly damage invulnerable targets or stack retained payload from previous battles indefinitely. Requires 8 total points in tiers 1+2 of this tree.

nodes.name: Three-Skill Rhythm
nodes.description: After all three slots succeed in order, the next Piercing Arrow's windup drops from 5 to 4 ticks (-20%). Sequence: actual Piercing Arrow hit -> successful Hunter's Mark -> successful Dash. Consumes the one-use speedup when the next arrow is accepted. A miss, barrier block, interrupted action, or encounter re-entry clears the sequence. Requires 8 total points in tiers 1+2 of this tree.

nodes.name: Windrunner
nodes.description: Dodge and Dash do not clear marks, arrow lineages, or three-slot timers. They do not interrupt a drawn or buffered Piercing Arrow. Marks still expire on schedule; movement does not extend them. Keystone talent; at most 2 per build.

nodes.name: Critical Hunter
nodes.description: The first critical arrow released in each battle gains 2 extra generations. Applies only when the locked build's effective reproduction number R=1, adding real arrow events and payload. Does not change continuation chance or affect exponential builds. Keystone talent; at most 2 per build.

nodes.name: Hunt at Any Range
nodes.description: Choose a near, medium, or far stance before a contract: near reduces minimum turn time by 10%, medium increases targeting distance by 10%, and far increases shared projectile lifetime by 10%. Stance locks for the contract. Each changes only its corresponding parameter; they do not stack. Keystone talent; at most 2 per build.
